name: Reader
text: The client-side skip link fails when JavaScript is disabled or slow to load, locking out keyboard users who need it most. A hybrid approach—server-side skip link hidden by default, then revealed via client-side JavaScript—covers all cases without layout disruption. Settle it with a live test: measure keyboard navigation success rates with both solutions in place.
